levels.note: OSM underpass w27796392 (layer -1, 46 m) and lift w1105572446 (level 0;-1). Trafikverket's lifts to tracks 1–3 and 4–5 (with stairs) imply a level below or above the platforms; that it is this tunnel is OSM only. Herrljunga kommun (2016) mentions a tunnel under the tracks for cycling and a 'södra uppgång' from the platforms.

answers.question: Herrljunga C (`740000040`): withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Partly settled. Entrances: OSM now tags four (two entrance=main toward Stationsgatan, two toward Järnvägsplatsen). Platform access: Trafikverket (2026-10-14) confirms lifts with stairs: Hiss 2 to tracks 1, 2 and 3, Hiss 3 to tracks 4 and 5; OSM has a tunnel (w27796392, layer -1) with a lift (w1105572446, level 0;-1) and four lift nodes, but the extract has no platform with a ref, so the draft still can't join them. Västtrafik lists lägen 1–7. Fix needed in OSM (platform refs) or in the edits file (platform_refs, paths_by_layer).

open: Which OSM lift node is Hiss 2, Hiss 3 (and a possible Hiss 1); whether the lifts run to the tunnel or another level: Trafikverket gives only tracks served.
Platform numbering on the ground (Västtrafik lists lägen 1–7; Trafikverket's lifts serve tracks 1–5): which platform faces which track, from no plan.
Level names as signposted and floor heights: no source.
Pars Café, Självfallet: no hours from an allowed source. Järnvägens Grill, Ellas garderob and Pressbyrån hours only from OSM.
Toilet fee: Jernhusen says card payment, OSM says no fee; amount not published.
No lockers, ticket machines or photo booth named by Jernhusen or Västtrafik for Herrljunga.
